title: Mixed face-degeneracy identities for an arbitrary simplicial object
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category and let $X:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal C$ be a simplicial object with faces $d_i:X_n\to X_{n-1}$ and degeneracies $s_j:X_{n-1}\to X_n$ [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object]. For every $n\geq1$ and $0\leq j\leq n-1$, one has $d_j\circ s_j=\mathrm{id}_{X_{n-1}}=d_{j+1}\circ s_j$. For $n\geq2$ one also has $d_i\circ s_j=s_{j-1}\circ d_i$ whenever $0\leq i<j\leq n-1$, and $d_i\circ s_j=s_j\circ d_{i-1}$ whenever $0\leq j<j+1<i\leq n$. The composites in the last two formulas use the indicated faces and degeneracies in the adjacent degrees.
